MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels useful because it would let me control a compatible lamp through the Alexa devices I already have.",
    "The Echo and bulb bundle fits my interest in Alexa by adding voice-controlled lighting, giving me a new use rather than just another speaker."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Dot and Echo Show 5 duplicate devices I recently bought in newer versions, so their familiarity does not give me a reason to choose them.",
    "Both Fire TV sticks cover a need already met by my recent 4K Max bundle, and the Lite would offer fewer capabilities.",
    "Desktop memory, an internal SSD, and a gaming case assume an upgrade or PC-building project I do not currently have. The card reader bundle also repeats an accessory I already own."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be taken as interest in any Alexa device, even when it is an older version of something I already have.",
    "My purchases of computer peripherals and practical accessories seem to be taken as interest in desktop-building parts, although those serve a different purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs are already covered, especially streaming, smart displays, and card reading.",
    "I am more interested in accessories that add a useful function to my existing setup than in duplicate devices or components that require an unplanned project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics but often miss the difference between extending my setup and repeating what I already own."
}
